summary: Confirmed s1_rat_accuracy_combined_ai_vs_no_ai against the complete markdown conversion, all six PDF pages, and the current extraction rules and codebook. No appendix is present. PDF p. 3 (printed p. 1772), Section V, reports 55% accuracy with both AI conditions combined versus 45% without AI, p < .05; the following actual-user subgroup results are separate. All three source quotations match their cited PDF pages. Study counts match Section III.D and Table I. Counts for this accuracy analysis are not explicitly printed, so n_treatment, n_control, and n_total appropriately remain null. The paper does not establish the scorer, observation unit, or uncertainty basis for this contrast; measure and unit remain null, and se_basis = unclear is permitted by the current rules. The with_ai, convergent, more_accurate, immediate, outcome_with_ai = true, within_person = null, and ai_vs_bau codes are supported by the randomized between-subjects procedures and accuracy definition. No eligible outcome or contrast is missing under rules 4-6: the other performance regressions adjust for actual AI use and task duration, while the additional numerical performance comparisons restrict the sample to actual AI users. Those results are correctly listed in not_extracted. Tables II-III were recovered with pymupdf.find_tables; Figure 1 is a task-interface screenshot.
